systems.owner: DGESS, Ministère de l'Enseignement de Base, de l'Alphabétisation et de la Promotion des Langues nationales (MEBAPLN)
systems.tiers: Paper forms filled per school and collected; keyed at the regional directorates (DREPPNF) on a local network installed by DGESS technicians, 8 April to 7 May 2024; regional bases cleaned and recovered 2 to 8 September 2024; primary level

note: The only system described is the yearly administrative census of primary schools, whose unit is the school, with forms keyed into STATEDUC 2 at regional directorates: class census, so no fact. The passages say nothing on how schools keep learner records.
